data.name: AION 64 KiB Artemis graphics controller with palette sequencer

introduced.event_name: NCC June 1982 — colour graphics and mouse interaction

additions: bounded palette-list prefetch and horizontal-retrace command sequencer
specification.continuity: Retain prior modes, five sprites with independent SRAM, pixel FIFO, character caches, refresh and host/DMA arbitration. Canonical detailed layout resides in the card specification.
